overview.description: The Simplify Affinity World Leaders Equity ETF (WLDR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks an index of multi-factor-selected securities from the developed markets, weighted in accordance with a proprietary risk model. WLDR was launched on Jan 17, 2018 and is issued by Simplify.

holdings.infoBox: WLDR is an equity ETF with a total of 119 individual holdings. The top holdings are Dell Technologies stock at 7.97%, Micron Technology at 7.27%, Seagate Technology Holdings at 4.83%, HP Inc. at 4.73%, and Cash & Cash Equivalents at 2.96%.
